card.heading: Head to head · Tic Tac Toe
card.blurb: One grid, two trainers. Take turns claiming a cell with a Pokémon that fits; three in a row wins.
card.info1: A wrong guess, or running out of time, passes the turn. Each Pokémon can be used once. Your opponent sees only which cells you have claimed.
card.info2: Steals: claim a cell your opponent holds by naming a different Pokémon that fits it and is rarer (a lower pick %). A stolen cell can be stolen back.
card.info3: Turn timer and categories apply to a game you send to a friend; finding an opponent uses 30-second turns and every category. Steals applies to both.
card.stealsTitle: Take cells from your opponent with a rarer Pokémon
card.classicTitle: Classic: a claimed cell stays claimed

invite: {host} challenges you to Pikadoku Tic Tac Toe! Take turns claiming cells with a Pokémon that fits: three in a row wins.
about: One Pikadoku grid, two trainers. Take turns claiming cells with a Pokémon that fits both its row and column.
share: Play me at Pikadoku Tic Tac Toe! Claim cells with Pokémon that fit: three in a row wins.

rules.gameText: One 3×3 grid. Take turns naming a Pokémon that fits a cell's row and column to claim it. Three in a row wins.
rules.missesText: A wrong guess, or running out of the {secs}-second turn, passes the turn. A Pokémon can be used once (a form and its species count as one).
rules.stealsText: You can claim a cell your opponent holds by naming a different Pokémon that fits and is rarer (a lower pick %; without rarity data, any different Pokémon). A failed steal passes the turn. A stolen cell can be stolen back.

last.notrarer: {player}: {pokemon} fits, but isn't rarer than the Pokémon there.
